description: Board of investment of Sri Lanka - The Land Acquisition Act - Order under Sec. 49A - Land Situated within Wathuwatta Grama Niladhari Division Udubaddawa D/S , Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notification under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that a specific parcel of land is required for a public purpose. It details the exact location, boundaries, and extent of the land, making it primarily concerned with land and property-related matters, which is the definition of a Land Gazette (Type 4). While it names the President, this is only in the context of his authority to issue the order under the Act; the core subject matter is the acquisition of land, not a description of government personnel or their portfolio responsibilities.
